Fig. 1. Reconstruction behavior comparison between real and AI-generated videos (generated by Zhipu Qingyan [43]). The original frames, reconstructed frames (reconstructed by WF-VAE), and pseudo-color map (Purple denotes low reconstruction error, whereas yellow denotes high reconstruction error). of reconstruction errors illustrate that reconstruction error can provide discriminative low-level forensic evidence for AI-generated video detection.

Fig. 2. Overview of the proposed ReConFuse framework. The input video is reconstructed by a pretrained video VAE, reconstruction errors are extracted as low-level forensic evidence, reconstruction error tokens are aligned and fused with semantic tokens, and Mamba is used for temporal modeling and video-level real/fake prediction.
